The '''Geslariena Folk Ballads''' are an oral and literary tradition associated with [[Geslariena]]-speaking communities in [[Valdris]] and [[Morvak]].

The extracted source describes the ballads as preserving the history and cultural values of river communities. They are tied to agriculture, seasonal cycles, navigation, family memory, and regional identity within [[Imperial Rhovland]].

== Draft Scope ==

This page keeps the tradition available for future Rhovlandian cultural history without inventing named ballads, canon performers, dates, or institutions.
